别被蛛网困住。当断则断，当立则立。
<@rolv.rem>胜利后获得收藏品及其他奖励</>
<@lv.item><火灶></>召唤“人间烟火”对沿途所有敌方单位造成真实伤害。
<@lv.item><废弃火灶></>召唤“饮露餐风”对所有沿途我方单位造成真实伤害。
<@rolv.rem>场地中有可以阻挡敌人行进路线的<碎石></>

グモの巣に囚われるなかれ。当に断つべくして則ち断ち、当に立つべくして則ち立つべし。
<@rolv.rem>勝利後、秘宝とその他報酬を獲得可能</>
<@lv.item><竈台></>「人間煙火」を召喚し、接触した敵全員に確定ダメージを与える
<@lv.item><破棄された竈台></>「飲露餐風」を召喚し、接触した味方ユニット全員に確定ダメージを与える
<@rolv.rem>敵の進攻ルートを遮る<礫岩>が出現</>

Do not get ensnared by the web. Be decisive, and follow through.
<@rolv.rem>Obtain Collectibles and other rewards upon victory</>
<@lv.item><Stove></> Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path.
<@lv.item><Derelict Stove></> Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path.
<@rolv.rem>This stage has <Rubble> that can block the enemy's path</>
彫鬼は20秒ごとに<無謂>一体を召喚する
$【Non-Key Target】$Will not prevent ending of battle even when still on field
$【非重要目標】$戦場にいても作戦終了に影響しない
$【非首要目标】$该目标在场不会阻止战斗结束
Summons 'Sapid Auspice' to deal True damage to all enemies in its path
Summons 'Vapid Blight' to deal True damage to all allied units in its path
Grants a marking buff to friendly units within range (ignores camouflage)

Grants a buff to enemies within skill range, granting ASPD +50, Movespeed +50% for 15s (target must re-enter skill range in order to receive buff benefits again
Enemies with this buff receive 75% less damage from unmarked friendly units
Consumes 20 DP to force the Statuegeist to close its mouth and stopping spawning enemies for a period of time

Will be deployed at the start of the stage, changing enemies' route
<@ba.rem>If the Rubble blocks enemies, they will destroy it</>
